import re,json,html
t=open('/workspace/products/research/apify-platform-pricing.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>',' ',t,flags=re.S)
s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
out=[]
for kw in ['compute unit','Compute unit','CU','per GB','20%','80%','revenue','pay per event','Pay per event','Free plan','\$5','\$0.','memory','Starter','monthly']:
  for m in list(re.finditer(re.escape(kw) if kw!='\$5' and kw!='\$0.' else kw,s))[:6]:
    out.append({'kw':kw,'snip':s[max(0,m.start()-200):m.end()+200]})
open('/workspace/products/research/apify-pricing-extract.json','w').write(json.dumps({'source':'https://apify.com/pricing','text_len':len(s),'snippets':out},indent=1))
print(len(s),len(out))
